criteria.text: Synchronous and asynchronous delegation require the caller session to belong to the authenticated user.
criteria.test_id: issue-1228-c1: sync and async delegation authenticate the caller-session owner

criteria.text: A user cannot delegate from another user's caller session, even when the session identifier is known.
criteria.test_id: issue-1228-c2: a known foreign caller-session id is denied

criteria.text: Existing valid same-user delegation continues to work.
criteria.test_id: issue-1228-c3: same-user sync and async delegation still succeed

criteria.text: Two-user HTTP tests cover both synchronous and asynchronous routes and assert no delegation is created on ownership failure.
criteria.test_id: issue-1228-c4: two-user HTTP denial creates no sync run or async delegation
